newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai to remove foreign ad signs from old city.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai to remove foreign ad signs from old city.

text.p: Shanghai has ordered fastfood giant Kentucky Fried Chicken (KFC) to remove its advertising signs from the old city area saying they damaged its Chinese feel, an official newspaper said on Tuesday.

The paper said the KFC advertising signs were erected without the approval of the local government, but a spokesman for KFC said they had never had to apply for such permission to put up signs outside any of its 22 outlets in Shanghai before.
The old Chinese city area of Shanghai, centred on the Yu Garden, has been extensively re-constructed in recent years with Chinese-style buildings and is popular with tourists.
The paper said a number of other foreign companies had applied to put up similar signs in the Yu Garden area, but gave no indication of the status of their applications.
